An '''asset's vest''' was an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn by [[Imperial Agent]]s of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were [[Color/Legends|gray]] in color with lighter brown sleeves.
